recovery_split.note: The sequential recovery was stopped only after investigation's completed summary and report. Its12 complete rows are retained; the final portal and legacy battle programs run once each in independent fresh profiles. A just-started duplicate portal process was terminated and is not counted.

limits: The aggregate selects the latest passing evidence for each program ID; overlapping groups must not be added together. Every initial failure remains indexed and its original output directory is untouched.

There is no single final-source all-cases run. The retained native33 and initial LiA20 snapshots predate co-op-only changes. Their offline campaign inventory implementation and original oracle files match the final source; the corrected LiA handoff fixture is covered by its separate95-check run.

The complete co-op18/525 run predates the final legacy-context loaded-owner fallback. The final focused45 and two context148 checks replace those three aggregate rows; other co-op rows retain their explicitly hashed earlier snapshot.

The interrupted native runner did not retain individual child exit codes or its final report. Recovered passes certify complete clean-exit logs, before/after saves, oracle input identity, strict semantic comparisons and repeatability; null exit codes remain null.
Original outcomes were recorded previously in the native engines. These runs replay the immutable references in the remake; they are not new recordings of the original engine.

Legacy saves preserve only their known live inventory. Unknown inactive-party inventory history cannot be reconstructed, and this change cannot restore fragments already lost in an old completed rescue.

Headless profiles are isolated, muted, FPS enabled and cursor free. No player profile was modified; audiovisual, GPU, multiplayer deployment outside loopback and release-platform certification are outside this index.
